photos.summary: Multiple Ziploc freezer bags filled with portioned cookie dough balls arranged on the counter, one labeled with a handwritten count. Freezer bake kits packed for storage after shaping.

photos.summary: Large square cambro container filled with mixed cookie dough resting on a kitchen scale, chocolate chips visible throughout. Mixed dough weighed before the overnight ferment.

photos.summary: Sheet tray packed with rows of portioned dough balls topped with pressed-in chocolate chips, alongside a plastic-wrapped tray of a few larger dough rounds. Shaped cookies staged before freezing.
